objectives.description: Define marker contract as comment block in helper
Create .claude/scripts/git-snapshot.sh with clean-tree no-op, default (patch+stash) mode, --branch mode, marker write, failure exit codes
Smoke check helper on dirty scratch tree

approaches_tried.approach: write patch file directly under $TASK_DIR before git stash push -u
approaches_tried.reason: stash -u sweeps the newly-written untracked patch file (and can delete an otherwise-empty $TASK_DIR), causing the later marker write to fail with No such file or directory

deviations.description: Default mode: git diff HEAD > patch AND git stash push (without drop)
deviations.reason: Patch is captured to a scratch mktemp file first and moved into $TASK_DIR after the stash step, and stash uses -u to include untracked files; verified necessary via temp-repo smoke test
deviations.annotation: *(altered: diff captured to scratch mktemp file, moved into task dir after stash; -u added for untracked coverage)*
